messages:
Sarah (AE): quick heads-up — Acme renewal conversation started by CSM. they want a >25% uplift off our current committed rates and are asking for a 60-day POC extension while they validate latency on Dedicated.
Miguel (SE): do we have recent perf numbers for their workload? sequence lengths, avg tokens?
Jordan (CS): shared perf last month: median p99 latency 110ms on their batch, avg token len ~220. they run a lot of short-chat sessions.
Sarah (AE): customer asks also for SOC2 evidence and SSO addendum before commit. legal flagged earlier.
Priya (Deal Desk): what is the ask re: pricing actually — 25% off list or 25% uplift to their previous committed discount? need clear ask to route.
Sarah (AE): they're asking to keep current committed unit price but increase commit by 20% vs last year, and want a 25% uplift discount applied to overage pricing and any new embedding units. messy.
Aiden (Finance): can you paste current ratecard lines? need ARR math to confirm 
Miguel (SE): quick snippet of rate diff we discussed:
```
Current committed: $0.015/token
List (on-demand): $0.020/token
Requested: committed on new term + 25% discount to on-demand -> effectively $0.015 -> wants same but for additional capacity
```
Sarah (AE): TL;DR — customer wants expanded commit with the same effective unit price plus concession to remove early-termination penalty during a 60-day validation.
Priya (Deal Desk): prelim thoughts — we can do a structured offer: 15% uplift discount on overage rates for a 12-month committed term if they sign by EOM, include a single 30-day free validation POC (CS-run). we should not remove ET penalties; maybe soften to pro-rated credits. Need legal signoff on SSO/SOC2 addendum.
Aiden (Finance): 15% uplift approved as desk-level concession, but only if billing is annual prepay or a 6-month commit with automated billing schedule. PMs: need ARR impact and revenue recognition note.
Jordan (CS): I can run the 30-day POC and collect perf metrics. need access by next Monday.
Miguel (SE): if POC shows server-side tail latency >200ms we need to allow an exit window. add that as a measurable SLA in the POC doc.
Sarah (AE): can Priya draft the commercial term text we can present? customer also requested a one-off clause to extend POC without penalty — we should push back.
Priya (Deal Desk): drafting now. include: 12-month commit, 15% overage uplift concession, one 30-day validation window, pro-rated early termination credit if evidence-based perf issues during POC. no blanket POC extensions.
dealbot: @Priya please upload deal form for approval: https://rdw.internal/deals/2037654321 (status: pending)
Priya (Deal Desk): uploaded. forwarding to legal for SSO/SOC2 addendum review. @Aiden please acknowledge billing term preference so I can include in doc.
Aiden (Finance): prefer annual prepay. if customer refuses, allow 6mo auto-bill. noted.
Sarah (AE): I'll tell the customer: we can offer 15% uplift concession for a 12mo commit, 30-day validation POC, legal will review SSO/SOC2, and ET softened to pro-rated credits tied to measured perf regressions. will push back on blanket 60-day free extension.
Jordan (CS): :thumbsup: I can coordinate the POC kickoff once legal signoff is in place.
Priya (Deal Desk): once legal clears, I'll mark deal as "DealDesk-approved" and route to finance for final billing clause.
Sarah (AE): thanks team — want to close this before EOM so I can include in the quarter. I'll update thread after customer reply.
(30m later) Priya (Deal Desk): DealDesk approved on paper — pending legal signoff and finance final billing schedule. putting in the tracker. :white_check_mark:
(2h later) Aiden (Finance): ACK, annual prepay requested. will send PO template to Sarah.
Sarah (AE): great, I'm looping Jordan and Miguel into the customer call tomorrow. will share recorded notes here.
